pages.title: Higgs Boson Crystal
pages.text: An excitation of the Higgs field, which fills all of space and gives particles their mass by dragging on them. Normally it decays in less than a zeptosecond. This crystal caught one before it could, and it is heavy in a way that seems to come from the field around it rather than the crystal.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Higgs couples most strongly to the heaviest particles, so I fed top quarks, gauge bosons and a Higgs field capacitor into the Hyperion Synchrotron. In the debris, a resonance I had been looking for froze solid.
